```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
# library(stringr)

```


# Purpose: Geolocate bovine inventory data at the municipality level in Mexico.
```{r load-mexico-geo-data}
mexico_geo <- readRDS(here("data", "processed", "mexico_geo.rds"))
glimpse(mexico_geo)
```

```{r load-bovine-data}
bovine_municip_data <- readRDS(here("data", "processed", "mexico_cattle_data_2022_cleaned.rds"))

glimpse(bovine_municip_data)
View(head(bovine_municip_data))

#look at matching problems
View(
    bovine_municip_data |> distinct(municipio) |> mutate(set = 'bovine') |> full_join(
        mexico_geo |> st_drop_geometry()|> distinct(NOMGEO) |> mutate(set = 'georef')
     |> rename(municipio = NOMGEO),
        by = "municipio"
    )
)


```

```{r geolocate-bovine-data}
source(here::here("src", "match_georeference.R"))

bovine_municip_data_geo <- match_georeference(
    data = bovine_municip_data,
    georeference = mexico_geo,
    data_state_col = "municipio",
    data_municipality_col = "entidad_federativa_y_municipio",
    geo_state_col = "NOMGEO",
    geo_municipality_col = "NOMMUN",
    geo_id_col = "CVEGEO"
)
```

# summarize by state
```{r summarize-by-state}
# Summarize bovine data by state
bovine_state_data <- bovine_municip_data |>
    group_by(municipio) |>
    summarise(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")

mexico_state_geo <- readRDS(here::here('data','processed','mexico_states_geo.rds'))

bovine_state_data_geo <- match_georeference(
    data = bovine_state_data,
    georeference = mexico_state_geo,
    data_state_col = "municipio",
    data_municipality_col = NULL,
    geo_state_col = "NOMGEO",
    geo_municipality_col = NULL,
    geo_id_col = "CVEGEO"
)


```

# save data
```{r save-data}
output_folder <- here::here('data','processed')
output_csv <- "geolocated_bovine_data.csv"
output_rds <- "geolocated_bovine_data.rds"
output_geojson <- "geolocated_bovine_data.geojson"

write.csv(bovine_municip_data_geo, file.path(output_folder, output_csv))
saveRDS(bovine_municip_data_geo, file.path(output_folder, output_rds))
sf::st_write(bovine_municip_data_geo, file.path(output_folder, output_geojson), delete_dsn = TRUE)

# save state summary
output_csv <- "geolocated_bovine_state_summary.csv"
output_rds <- "geolocated_bovine_state_summary.rds"
output_geojson <- "geolocated_bovine_state_summary.geojson"
write.csv(bovine_state_data_geo, file.path(output_folder, output_csv))
saveRDS(bovine_state_data_geo, file.path(output_folder, output_rds))
sf::st_write(bovine_state_data_geo, file.path(output_folder, output_geojson), delete_dsn = TRUE)
```
